criteria.description: Patient must have a history of lumbar disc herniation.
documentation_required: Prior operative report detailing the initial surgery for lumbar disc herniation.
Imaging studies (MRI or CT) demonstrating evidence of recurrent disc herniation at the same level as the previous surgery.

criteria.description: Patient must have failed conservative management for the recurrent lumbar disc herniation.
documentation_required: Therapy records documenting a minimum of 6 weeks of physical therapy or equivalent non-operative treatment.
Clinical notes from physicians detailing failure of conservative management (e.g., pain control, functional improvement).

criteria.description: Patient must have persistent radicular symptoms attributable to the recurrent disc herniation.
documentation_required: Clinical notes from physicians detailing specific radicular pain (e.g., sciatica) and neurological deficits (e.g., numbness, tingling, weakness) related to the recurrent disc herniation.
Imaging studies demonstrating the recurrent disc herniation causing nerve root compression.

criteria.description: Patient must have failed non-operative management for persistent radicular symptoms.
documentation_required: Clinical notes from physicians detailing failure of conservative management (e.g., pain control, functional improvement) for the persistent radicular symptoms.
Imaging studies demonstrating the recurrent disc herniation causing nerve root compression.

Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Non-Indications: Procedures performed before the required post-operative duration has elapsed (e.g., < 6 months from prior surgery).
Neck pain or radiculopathy without objective physical exam findings or concordant advanced imaging (MRI/CT).
Failure to complete the mandatory trial of conservative therapy (minimum 6 weeks of PT/medications) unless contraindicated.
Active tobacco or nicotine use without verified 6-week cessation and negative cotinine laboratory test.
Presence of unmanaged significant behavioral or mental health disorders, active opioid/alcohol use disorder, or secondary gain.
Documentation required: Operative reports from prior cervical decompression or fusion surgery (confirming levels and surgical date).
Plain cervical spine X-rays with flexion and extension lateral views showing fusion and stability.
Advanced imaging reports (MRI or CT of cervical spine) documenting neural structure compression or stenosis concordant with symptoms.
Detailed physical examination records documenting functional impairment and objective neurological deficits.
Physical therapy records and pharmacy prescription logs documenting >= 6 weeks of continuous conservative therapy.
Objective cotinine laboratory test results (serum, urine, or saliva) confirming nicotine-free status (or signed never-smoker attestation).
Behavioral/mental health evaluation notes confirming absence of unmanaged psychiatric or substance use disorders.
